cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(OasisSceneRenderer LANGUAGES C CXX OBJCXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_compile_definitions(_LIBCPP_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL)
set(BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(RUST_SHADER_FFI ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${OASIS_ENGINE_SOURCE}" engine)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/entry.cpp" "extern \"C\" int oasis_scene_renderer_api_version(){return 1;}\n")
add_library(OasisSceneRenderer SHARED "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/entry.cpp")
target_link_options(OasisSceneRenderer PRIVATE "LINKER:-all_load")
target_link_libraries(OasisSceneRenderer PRIVATE wescene-renderer "${OASIS_RUST_SHADER}" "-framework AppKit" "-framework Metal" "-framework MetalFX" "-framework QuartzCore" "-framework CoreText" "-framework OpenGL" "-framework AudioToolbox" "-framework AudioUnit" "-framework CoreGraphics")
set_target_properties(OasisSceneRenderer PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR "@rpath" MACOSX_RPATH ON)
